selection.selection_basis: Compare frozen and adapted encoders only on prior development. Fixed posterior cutoffs; full coverage/F1 no lower and negative FP/extra characters no higher than original E5. Maximize covered names, minimize extra characters, then maximize F1; retain frozen incumbent on a tie. Strict per-case regressions remain separate and cannot be waived by this ranking.
selection.amendment: Original 1000-ID evaluation stopped before inference on exact training text overlap. Keep identical model/decoder/threshold and original IDs; exclude only exact overlap, without replacement. This is not retuning.

source.purpose: external person-boundary stress test, not private-person policy accuracy

selection_amendment.reason: Original held-out evaluation blocked before inference on exact text overlap
selection_amendment.filter: Remove exact SHA256 UTF-8 training/validation text matches only

pipeline: Public analyze and separate actual stars mask on every retained sentence
limitations: Amended nonoverlapping subset of the original fixed sample, not the original 1000-row benchmark. Exclusion uses exact text contamination only, never labels, model predictions or results. Upstream E5 exposure remains unknown. KLUE includes public and fictional people; sentence bootstrap does not account for source-document dependence.
